main_text.head: AD GENEROSVM ET NOBILISSIMUM D. Vencellaum M. de Zastriselli, elegantissima Th Bezæ Poëmata publicantem.
main_text.p: OTe mirificis Veneranda dotibus, ô te Ter Zastrisefelli diuitem! Nimirum sua non tantùm claustrisque serisque Plebes recondit silior:
Immò arcana potens Stagirai scripta magistri, Orbi Philippus inuidet.
At tu, noster opes tibi quas donauerat Ṽni Cunctis fruendas exhibes.
Sic sua qua immeritis nimiù nimiúmq; modestus Damnarat ignibus Maro,
Iá Varus, iá Tucea, bonis iam carmina iussit Præstare Cæsar posteris.
Sic generosa suo diduci e palmite Vitis Latas sinit propagines:
Sic gazas gremio Tellus fœcunda latentes Cunctis fruendas exhibet:
Denique ☉ Omnipotes sic munera lucis ☉ aurae Facit benignus publica.
Et propria sine labe suos Sol aureus ignes Præbet fruendos omnibus.
Mirum igitur dictu, lauro non dispare dispar Ambos Venustat indoles,
Comendatq; pium pariter messobria BEZAM, Munifica ZASTRISELLIVM.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout where present; Greek/symbol marks (☉) in line 9 are uncertain. Lines 1–2 of the heading and several verse words are doubtful on the scan (e.g. "Vencellaum", "Ṽni", "Cæsar"); the signature "IAC. LBETIVS" reads as printed but is uncertain. Verse lines are set as paragraphs, not as list items.
